Operating Principles

What stays the same when everything changes.

The same five lessons kept showing up — across industries and roles, client side and agency side, as an employee and as a founder.

1

Distribution beats production.

A 70-point product in the right channel, talking to the right audience, performs like a 90-point one. The reverse almost never happens.

2

Price is a test you can run.

We raised prices and sales didn't move. The market will tell you what your work is worth — if you ask.

3

Strategy only counts when every team ships it.

And teams only ship a strategy that accounts for their own goals. Alignment isn't persuasion after the fact — it's designing a plan where every stakeholder wins by executing it.

4

The best channel is where your users already talk about you.

You rarely need to build a community from scratch. Find the one that already exists, and show up early.

5

Downside contained is upside earned.

Growth gets the applause; risk control keeps the score. Knowing what can go wrong before it does — and containing it fast when it does — protects more value than most campaigns create.
